what: Frictionless captures — thoughts from the discussion worth keeping that are not yet tracked nodes. A note is PROSE and a TIMESTAMP. Everything else is optional context.
why: Capture must be near-zero friction or thoughts are lost in the gap between surfacing and acting. A note is a holding pen: non-terminal, un-cast, un-proved, carrying no false weight. It gets picked up by /intent if it grows into work. Written by skill:/note.
owner: the notes store owns writes. THERE IS NO CHOKEPOINT AND THERE IS NOT MEANT TO BE ONE — Akien, 2026-08-10: 'it just takes a note, there prolly doesn't need to be a workflow for it'. This clause used to read 'the single commons emit chokepoint validates every record against the template below (Law 6)', and that sentence was false for three weeks: 22 of 33 records did not conform and nothing refused one. The correction is NOT that the gate went missing — it is that the template was over-specified for what a note is. Law 4 is satisfied by having no rule here rather than by an unenforced one.

template.text: REQUIRED — string, the note itself, in prose. This is the note; everything else is furniture.
template.date: REQUIRED — ISO-8601 absolute date, the timestamp.
template.id: optional — stable unique id; /note mints one from the filename
template.author: optional — who captured it (CC | Akien | …). Defaults to CC: the store is mostly CC's own, per the 2026-08-10 ruling.
template.relates_to: optional — id/address of a node/ticket/artifact it hangs off
template._any_other_key: optional — 'maybe other context if you wanted to add it' (Akien, 2026-08-10). A note carrying extra context is a note, not a malformed record.

the_two_kinds_in_this_directory.measured: 2026-08-10: 33 records. 11 carry text+date. 22 do not, and 19 of those 22 carry a `held-` filename prefix.
the_two_kinds_in_this_directory.notes: prose + timestamp, written by /note, the subject of this charter. These are what the /note firing count counts.
the_two_kinds_in_this_directory.held_design_documents: the `held-*` files plus overnight-drain.json, tickets-and-tasks.json and 2026-08-02-opus-compatibility-pass.json — hand-authored design documents that share this address and are NOT notes. They are LEFT WHERE THEY ARE and are not rewritten: Law 7 makes a record of truth permanent, and quietly reshaping 22 files into conformance would be exactly the erasure that law forbids. They carry ~180 distinct hand-authored field names between them, which is the signature of direct writes and is why no template will ever describe them.
the_two_kinds_in_this_directory.how_they_are_told_apart: by the template, at read time: skills/note/intention+why.json declares counted_by with conform_to_template: true. That was filed as a workaround for an absent gate; under this ruling it is simply the correct reader, because there is no gate and is not meant to be one.
the_two_kinds_in_this_directory.the_owed_question: whether the held-* documents should eventually move to a store of their own is a live design detail, not a defect. It is NOT held here — a store charter is not a place to keep an open question.

notes_on_the_store: A note is NOT a decision, a record of truth, or a proof — if it is one of those, it belongs in decisions/ or a VALIDATION, not here.
Non-terminal by nature: a note may be superseded, promoted to an intention, or dropped.

The store's history, from Akien 2026-08-10: it existed so HE could leave CC notes; he stopped using it and it was deleted; CC started putting things at the address again, so it was rebuilt to the tool. It is now mostly CC's. That history is why it has no workflow and should not grow one without a reason nobody has yet.
